notes.title: Whimsy Release/Smol Updates
notes.content:
Hi, frens! Thank you for all of your feedback over the past week, I want to hug you all - meet me at the local Chili's and we will do a group hug see you soon

A few things I fixed:
[list]
Dialogue - that was clunky before!
The Octagon puzzle - a lot smoother to use!
Small bugs - smushed many, but please let me know if you find others!
[/list]
